label: configurator • explain folder automations from the automations guide topic
query: What are watchers in Osaurus and when should I use one instead of a schedule?
notes: Feature-explanation path: watchers are now folder automations, documented in the `automations` topic (the retired `watchers`/`watcher` ids alias to it). osaurus_help read of the automations topic, then an answer grounded in that text (folder-change automations vs schedule automations).

rubric: Explains that a folder automation (formerly a watcher) runs an agent or workflow when files in a folder change (event-driven), contrasted with a schedule automation which runs on a timed cadence, grounded in the guide content rather than invented details or a refusal.
